en: A monochrome postcard-style image showing a heraldic composition. Two men in historical mining uniforms with feathered hats flank a large coat of arms. The shield bears a beehive surrounded by bees and crossed mining hammers above it, all framed with floral garlands. Above the figures appears the curved inscription "BERGSTADT BRAND." Decorative vines border the upper part, and a low ornamental fence with flowers runs along the bottom.
